title: Replacement J6 pilot registration after causal handoff validation
release_condition: J6A must produce a passing durable result for every fixed deterministic causality, parity-accounting, anti-leakage, replay, and malformed-input gate.
purpose: This predecessor job required a new pilot to be frozen only after the public temporal-boundary handoff and integrated ledger were validated. Its registration is now satisfied, but it never authorized stochastic sampling by itself.

fresh history seeds and a new matched-history cohort disjoint from J6
new cell counts, event-resolution thresholds, compute caps, and fixed stop rule
unconditional abort/denominator semantics for unresolved handoffs
preflight gates covering causal prefixes, temporal-boundary resolution, action binding, truth/future exclusion, replay, and row completeness
an explicit statement that J6 remains closed censored and is not pooled with the replacement cohort
prohibited_until_registered: Run schedule arms or bootstrap replicates
Reuse J6 histories, rows, selected rates, or event counts as an adaptive extension
stop_rule: If J6A fails or is censored, retain this job as blocked. If J6A passes, create a separate immutable J6B contract before any stochastic action; no aspect of J6 may be repaired, resampled, or reinterpreted.
registration_boundary: J6A and R0 permit only a new immutable pilot registration. The pilot must freeze the exact integrated later-action supersession semantics and require a separate preflight before any new stochastic history.
registration_result: A disjoint 272-history, 2176-arm, newly rated 0.06 replacement design is frozen with source/runtime hashes, full public/private boundaries, matched keys, unconditional loss, resolution gates and fixed stop. Zero replacement histories, arms, and bootstrap replicates were generated in this registration tick. J6 remains closed censored.
next_operation: Run only the new pilot's separate deterministic fail-closed preflight; production is unarmed.
